events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Align on scope and secure data access
events.decision: Can Quinta Azul open access to sales data and Spanish retail contacts?
agenda: Present the assessment objective and the Research plan
Review the data and people access the evidence work needs
Decide on access to sales data and retail contacts

events.label: Check-in: market size
events.purpose: Review market size and growth findings
events.decision: Which Spanish retail segments should the findings pack focus on?
agenda: Present market size and growth by segment
Discuss what the segments mean for the remaining Research work
Decide the segments the findings pack should focus on

events.label: Findings sign-off
events.decision: Is Spain attractive enough to justify designing entry options?
agenda: Present the findings pack on Spain's attractiveness
Review competitor profiles, buyer needs and the gap assessment
Decide whether Spain justifies designing entry options

events.label: Check-in: entry options
events.purpose: Review entry options before the roadmap
events.decision: Which Spain entry option should the roadmap and decision pack detail?
agenda: Present the entry options compared on agreed criteria
Discuss the trade-offs between the options
Decide which option the roadmap and decision pack detail

events.label: Final readout
events.purpose: Approve the Spain go or no-go decision
events.decision: Approve the Spain go or no-go decision and, if go, the entry plan?
agenda: Present the business case and the entry roadmap
Review the go or no-go decision pack and entry plan
Decide on approval of the go or no-go and the entry plan
